; ANA's strskp function ; 2014-01-22 : MGL. Renamed for inclusion in the red_ namespace. ; ; 2014-03-05 : THI. Handle both arrays of strings and single strings. function red_strskp,st,del pos = [strpos(st,del)] if size(pos,/dim) gt 0 then begin return,strmid(st,transpose(pos+(pos ge 0)*strlen(del))) end else begin return,st end end
